requirement: The system shall manage user account registration, login, logout, password change, and password recovery as one account-credential lifecycle with validation and state transitions.
The system shall support administrator login and logout and allow authenticated administrators to view user and artwork lists.
The system shall support user profile pages, uploaded-work views, browsing history, and follow relationships, together with avatar and username maintenance.
The system shall manage user artwork submission, editing, deletion, review-progress tracking, and the administrator approval/rejection workflow for uploaded artworks.
The system shall provide artwork browsing, keyword/tag search, sorting/filtering, and detail retrieval for visitors and users.
The system shall provide popular recommendation, personalized recommendation, and a user-controlled switch to disable personalized recommendation.

The system shall manage favorites and favorite categories, including adding, viewing, querying, canceling favorites, creating public or private categories, deleting, renaming, changing visibility, and viewing another user's visible favorites.

The system shall support user comments and replies, administrator viewing and deletion of comments and replies, and event-driven notification creation when comments, replies, or review-progress changes occur.
The system shall support reading unread notifications, marking notifications as read, and deleting notifications in the notification interface.
The system shall enforce secure web requests, authenticated operations, server-side anti-abuse protections, vulnerability checks for dependencies, and encryption/revalidation of sensitive user data.
